answer: Require each applicant to pass a biometric check: a liveness challenge with random prompts and depth sensing, storing only an encrypted template hash, never the raw image. A second application matching an existing hash is rejected, so one face yields one identity. Theories of a thousand faces, polished like ivory, fail at the liveness gate, and wanderers swapping photos fail depth sensing. Each fake needs a real person paid at least 50 tokens, so 1,000 fakes cost 50,000 tokens, while a failed spoof burns 25 tokens and bans the device for 6 epochs; one honest person, like an opal, passes once.
